title: Especialista PMO Remote Work Full-time employee
description:
Job description

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.


Main responsibilities

Se você é uma pessoa organizada , com visão estratégica e que se motiva por transformação , essa é a sua oportunidade. Nesta posição de Especialista PMO , você terá o papel central de garantir a execução e o sucesso dos projetos mais importantes e transformadores da companhia, sendo a ponte entre a operação e o C-level. Seu trabalho será essencial para traduzir a estratégia em ação e resultados concretos.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Gerir o portfólio de Projetos Estratégicos: Responsável pela priorização, planejamento, acompanhamento e controle de projetos de alta complexidade e impacto na companhia, garantindo que estejam alinhados à estratégia de negócio.
  • Monitoramento e Reporte de Performance: Desenvolver e manter um sistema robusto de indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) para os projetos, preparando reports de status e análises de risco de forma clara e objetiva para apresentação direta ao C-level (Diretoria e Presidência).
  • Garantia da Execução: Atuar como um facilitador e agente de mudança, identificando e removendo impedimentos, gerenciando dependências e mitigando riscos que possam comprometer os prazos e o escopo dos projetos.
  • Governança de Projetos: Estabelecer e manter os padrões de metodologia, processos e ferramentas de gestão de projetos (PMO Framework) para garantir consistência e qualidade na execução dos projetos da companhia.
  • Comunicação e Engajamento: Ser o ponto focal e garantir a comunicação fluida e eficaz entre os diversos stakeholders envolvidos, desde as equipes operacionais até a alta liderança.
  • Suporte à Tomada de Decisão: Fornecer dados e insights de progresso e performance dos projetos para subsidiar decisões estratégicas da liderança executiva.

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência Comprovada em PMO ou Gestão de Projetos: Sólida experiência na gestão de portfólio e/ou programas de projetos transformacionais em empresas de médio ou grande porte.
  • Experiência com Alto Nível de Exposição: Histórico de sucesso em acompanhamento, comunicação e reporte de projetos diretamente para C-level e alta gestão.
  • Conhecimento em Metodologias de Projetos: Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em metodologias de gestão de projetos (e.g., PMBOK, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, OKR).
  • Análise de Dados e KPIs: Habilidade avançada em análise de dados, métricas de projeto (e.g., Earned Value, Burn Rate) e elaboração de dashboards e relatórios executivos.
  • Ensino Superior Completo: Preferencialmente em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação será um diferencial.
  • Habilidades Interpessoais: Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, capacidade de negociação, influência e resiliência para lidar com ambientes de alta pressão e stakeholders diversos.

Será considerado como um diferencial:

  • Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ou similar (e.g., ACP, PSM).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de portfólio (e.g., MS Project, Trello, Jira, Asana, Clarizen).
  • Experiência em empresas com atuação em negócios digitais ou em projetos de transformação digital .
  • Inglês Fluente: Essencial para comunicação e documentação.

Additional information

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

a FARM nasceu com a missão de emocionar, encantar e realizar aqui, tudo começa e termina com pessoas. desde o desenho das peças até a costura e a compra, tudo é pensado nos mínimos detalhes por gente. valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho seguro, diverso e acolhedor, com portas abertas e muito diálogo.

o que começou como um pequeno estande numa feira de moda tornou-se uma loja e depois uma rede de lojas que conquistou cidades, estados e até outros países. hoje, somos mais de 100 lojas espalhadas pelo Brasil inteiro, sem contar as localizadas fora do país, com mais de 2000 colaboradores para fazer tudo acontecer.

vem fazer parte do nosso time!

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

estamos à procura de gente que ama conhecer gente, que escuta de verdade, sente vontade de entender o outro, ama desafios e gosta da jornada até lá, mesmo que tenha alguns obstáculos no caminho.

QUER FAZER PARTE DESSA JORNADA DE VENDAS E ATENDIMENTO COM A GENTE?

  • Realizar o atendimento ao cliente com gentileza;
  • Garantir eficiência:
  • Prestando atendimento online através dos canais digitais;
  • Realizando abertura e fechamento do caixa;
  • Recebendo, conferindo e enviando mercadorias;
  • Finalizando as vendas;
  • Apoiando a gerente no acompanhamento dos indicadores de venda
  • Sendo o responsável administrativo da loja, nas seguintes atividades: gestão de solicitação de insumos, gerenciamento das contas a pagar, operação dos processos de omnichannel, garantia de que processos e equipamentos da loja estejam em pleno funcionamento
  • Oferecendo suporte à gerência em atividades diversas.
  • Colaborar com a gerência para garantir a experiência física da loja, mantendo-a atraente e organizada e encantando sempre os clientes;
  • Se sentir bem como você é;
  • Respeitar a todos como são;
  • Ser uma pessoa dinâmica, flexível, ágil de se adaptar e organizada;
  • Ter visão estratégica para entregar resultados e soluções de problemas;
  • Entender que o dia a dia é desafiador não só porque contempla muitas atividades, mas porque você está ali ajudando a realizar sonho e melhorar a autoestima das clientes;
  • Ter habilidade de facilidade de comunicação (oratória e “escutatória”) facilita demais o bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Conhecimento básico do pacote Office e habilidade com ferramentas tecnológicas;
  • Desejável experiência anterior na função e no sistema LINX;
  • Flexibilidade de horário;
  • Step 3: etapa de vídeo de apresentação 3 etapa de vídeo de apresentação
  • Step 5: entrevista com a gerente da loja 5 entrevista com a gerente da loja
  • Step 6: entrevista com a supervisão responsável 6 entrevista com a supervisão responsável

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

title: Cloud & Industrial Edge Architect
description:
Job Overview

Cloud & Industrial Edge Architect – Siemens Energy

Join to apply for the role of Cloud & Industrial Edge Architect at Siemens Energy. You’ll help design and operate the hybrid (on‑prem + cloud) infrastructure that powers Siemens Energy’s industrial digitalisation solutions. With solid experience in Microsoft Azure and working knowledge of GCP and AWS, you’ll contribute to building secure, reliable, and scalable connections between industrial (OT) environments and cloud platforms, enabling data services, analytics, and smarter operations.

Responsibilities

  • Support the design and implementation of hybrid architectures connecting edge/on‑prem systems with the cloud.
  • Deploy and maintain cloud and edge components for data ingestion, storage, and monitoring.
  • Enable secure OT–IT integrations (VPN, private links, authentication, certificates).
  • Develop Infrastructure‑as‑Code and CI/CD automation practice.
  • Monitor and tune performance, cost, and reliability of deployed environments.
  • Work closely with automation, data, and product teams to bring industrial data into digital platforms.
  • Participate in solution reviews, proposals, and technical discussions with internal and external partners.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years crafting, building, and operating cloud/hybrid infrastructure for production systems.
  • 3+ years hands‑on with Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, networking, security, IAM, monitoring).
  • Exposure to GCP or AWS (some practical experience is welcome, not mandatory).
  • Strong hybrid integration skills: site‑to‑cloud connectivity, private networking, DNS, certificates, edge/IoT.
  • IaC & DevOps: Terraform (or Bicep/ARM), Git‑based workflows, pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), artifact registries.
  • Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes/AKS (or similar), registry, ingress, telemetry, backup/DR patterns.
  • Awareness of data flows from OT systems (OPC UA, MQTT, or equivalent).
  • Security‑by‑design approach (identity, secrets management, policy‑as‑code, vulnerability management, compliance).
  • Effective collaborator communication with multi‑functional and international teams.
  • Degree in Engineering (any), Computer Science, or proven equivalent experience.
  • Proficient English; knowledge of other languages is an asset.
  • Relevant certifications (Azure, GCP, AWS) are a plus.
  • Familiarity with edge runtimes (Azure IoT Edge, Kubernetes at the edge), time‑series/observability stacks.

About The Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonising the industrial sector. Growing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. Our focus is on decarbonising manufacturing and adopting balanced approaches with industry clients, global networks, tech, and coordinated implementation.

About Siemens Energy

Siemens Energy meets the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than ~100,000 dedicated employees, we generate electricity for over 16% of the global community and use our technology to help protect people and the environment.

Our Office

Siemens Energy’s location in One Cotroceni Park, Bucharest, offers a vibrant community. The office is surrounded by green spaces, shopping, and is within walking distance of the Academia Militara subway station.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We celebrate diversity across 130 nationalities and do not discriminate based on ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability.

Benefits

  • Flexible work schedules for a good work‑life balance.
  • Access to ongoing professional and personal development through training programs.
  • Meal tickets and support for lunch.
  • Bookster for book lovers.
  • Medical subscription for health and safety.
  • Private Pension Pilon III for future security.
  • Well‑being initiatives.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next‑generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive‑level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Thanks to our proprietary data infrastructure, we accelerate growth, improve margins, and compound results across our client portfolio.

Darkroom has evolved from a boutique design studio to one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Associate Director of Creative who will act as a player/coach, leading a pod of designers and delivering AI‑powered creative direction, marketing design, and UI/UX projects. The role requires deep experience in integrating AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Midjourney to drive creative efficiency and quality.

Reporting to the Director of Creative, you will advocate for design processes and supervise junior designers across paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. Your first 60 days will focus on integrating ChatGPT and AI into the creative workflow and building training programs.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of designers, initially 1–2 direct reports, providing strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and escalation handling.
  • Conduct weekly one‑on‑ones to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality output, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and deadlines.
  • Collaborate with marketers, strategists, developers, and clients to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal client work processes in coordination with the Director of Creative and provide training and feedback.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Champion AI‑powered work, leading trainings on best practices and building efficient workflows with the Director of Creative.
  • Lead creative direction engagements that transform paid or organic marketing channels with deliverables such as content calendars, creative briefs, and strategic proposals.
  • Lead 1–2 UI/UX engagements focused on branded e‑commerce websites, emphasizing conversion‑focused UX and clarity.
  • Present design and creative direction work to clients, explaining choices based on UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 3–6+ years of senior‑level design experience, with at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred; experience in creative direction, marketing design, or responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web, marketing, and branding skills; color theory, hierarchy, composition, typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience working with AI tools and producing client‑ready assets powered by AI outputs (required).
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, design solutions, and execute effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, Variants) essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) required.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is built for A‑players. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring rigor. We hold a high bar for performance but support each other relentlessly.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in business, you’ll thrive here.

Remote‑First Culture

  • Live remote; employees in New York or Lisbon (opening 2026) adopt hybrid with weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations include Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental leave: flexible benefits to support new parents.
  • Endless growth opportunities: cross‑functional collaboration beyond job description.

Location: fully remote (EST timezone); open to Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal‑opportunity workplace—dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Analista De Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.
  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

As a Lead DevOps Engineer , you’ll own and evolve cloud infrastructure that powers AI‑driven products, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security across distributed systems. You’ll lead modernization efforts in AWS, streamline CI/CD pipelines, and champion automation and observability best practices. This role combines hands‑on technical leadership with strategic impact, offering the opportunity to shape infrastructure standards and drive innovation in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.

  • Upgrade AWS Aurora Postgres clusters to the latest supported versions, ensuring high availability, data integrity, and minimal downtime.
  • Own and improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for production deployments, covering containerized services and Lambda‑based workloads.
  • Manage infrastructure as code using AWS CDK (TypeScript) and other IaC practices to drive automation, consistency, and repeatability.
  • Consolidate and optimize shared tooling, utility scripts, and reusable components across multiple repositories.
  • Collaborate with engineering and leadership to define the infrastructure roadmap, influence architecture decisions, and promote DevOps culture and best practices.

MUST HAVES

  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps / Site Reliability Engineering, including ownership of multi‑quarter infrastructure projects or leadership roles.
  • Strong expertise with AWS services such as ECS, RDS/Aurora, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, CDK, and core networking (VPC design, routing, subnets, security groups, NAT, DNS/Route 53, load balancers).
  • Proficient with Docker, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD patterns for cloud‑native applications.
  • Deep knowledge of Postgres administration, including upgrades, backups, and performance tuning.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills with TypeScript, Python, or Bash.
  • Proven ability to architect scalable, secure, and reliable cloud environments, including DR strategies and cost‑optimization practices.
  • Experience improving observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting) and using it to guide reliability and cost improvements.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working closely with engineers and stakeholders to execute infra roadmaps.
  • Self‑driven, practical, and detail‑oriented, comfortable making decisions, documenting trade‑offs, and delivering high‑quality results with limited supervision.
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Familiarity with AI/ML workflows or cloud‑based AI services.
  • Experience with AWS Bedrock or similar generative AI platforms.
  • Exposure to Cursor or other modern AI‑enhanced developer tools.
  • Understanding of security and scaling best practices for distributed environments.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch, etc.).

a FARM nasceu com a missão de emocionar, encantar e realizar. aqui, tudo começa e termina com pessoas. desde o desenho das peças até a costura e a compra, tudo é pensado nos mínimos detalhes por gente. valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho seguro, diverso e acolhedor, com portas abertas e muito diálogo.

o que começou como um pequeno estande numa feira de moda tornou-se uma loja e depois uma rede de lojas que conquistou cidades, estados e até outros países. hoje, somos mais de 100 lojas espalhadas pelo Brasil inteiro, sem contar as localizadas fora do país, com mais de 2000 colaboradores para fazer tudo acontecer.

vem fazer parte do nosso time!

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

estamos à procura de gente que ama conhecer gente, que escuta de verdade, sente vontade de entender o outro, ama desafios e gosta da jornada até lá, mesmo que tenha alguns obstáculos no caminho.

quer fazer parte desta jornada de vendas e atendimento com a gente?

  • Realizar o atendimento ao cliente com gentileza;
  • Garantir eficiência:
  • Prestando atendimento online através dos canais digitais;
  • Realizando abertura e fechamento do caixa;
  • Recebendo, conferindo e enviando mercadorias;
  • Finalizando as vendas;
  • Apoiando a gerente no acompanhamento dos indicadores de venda
  • Sendo o responsável administrativo da loja, nas seguintes atividades: gestão de solicitação de insumos, gerenciamento das contas a pagar, garantia de que processos e equipamentos da loja estejam em pleno funcionamento
  • Oferecendo suporte à gerência em atividades diversas.
  • Colaborar com a gerência para garantir a experiência física da loja, mantendo-a atraente e organizada e encantando sempre os clientes;
  • Se sentir bem como você é;
  • Respeitar a todos como são;
  • Ser uma pessoa dinâmica, flexível, ágil de se adaptar e organizada;
  • Ter visão estratégica para entregar resultados e soluções de problemas;
  • Entender que o dia a dia é desafiador não só porque contempla muitas atividades, mas porque você está ali ajudando a realizar sonho e melhorar a autoestima das clientes
  • Ter habilidade de facilidade de comunicação (oratória e “escutatória”) facilita demais o bom relacionamento interpessoal
  • Conhecimento básico do pacote Office e habilidade com ferramentas tecnológicas
  • Desejável experiência anterior na função e no sistema LINX
  • Flexibilidade de horário
  • Step 3: etapa de vídeo de apresentação 3 etapa de vídeo de apresentação
  • Step 5: entrevista com a gerente da loja 5 entrevista com a gerente da loja
  • Step 6: entrevista com a supervisão responsável 6 entrevista com a supervisão responsável

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

title: Tracking and QA Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Tracking and QA Analyst role at Launch Potato .

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

Contract Non-Negotiables

  • You’re available to work 40 hours per week, Monday - Friday.
  • You’re comfortable working somewhere between 7:00 am to 6:00 pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • You have outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • You're highly detail-oriented and reliable.
  • You have excellent administrative skills with the ability to multitask and adapt in a fast-paced remote environment.

YOUR ROLE

You are a detail-oriented, results-driven professional with a passion for maintaining the highest standards of quality and efficiency in operational processes and procedures. Everything goes through QA, so you will be directly responsible for ensuring the success of our campaign launches which connects millions of consumers to our clients monthly! You will also be responsible for overseeing and optimizing our operations to ensure they meet and exceed industry standards and organizational objectives. Your unwavering attention to detail and thorough analysis skills will be invaluable in detecting and identifying potential problems within our daily operations. Additionally, you have a proven track record in quality management, process improvement, and possess industry-specific knowledge. Your ability to collaborate and work cross-functionally, leveraging your industry-specific expertise, will enable you to implement effective solutions, making a significant impact on our company's operational excellence.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Supporting quality assurance for our financebuzz.com and allaboutcookies.org domains.
  • Maintaining the currently implemented process for building, setting up, and testing tracking URLs across all campaigns and platforms to ensure the highest quality.
  • Reconciling reporting between our internal tracking platforms and external client platforms to ensure proper tracking.
  • Conducting investigations when there is an offer discrepancy or malfunction and finding suitable resolutions.
  • Reviewing platform documentation and internal product setup to find areas of improvement and working with the Operations team to determine next steps to close the gap.
  • Working closely with the Operations team to ensure QA standards are consistently met.
  • Communicating with internal stakeholders on process improvements.
  • Analyzing ad hoc performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Monitoring revenue, conversions, impressions, and clicks to ensure proper reporting when a new offer is created, links are changed, or in other necessary circumstances.
  • Monitoring offer goals to ensure all goals are firing properly after creation.
  • Ensuring QA is successfully implemented with any new process that is rolled out.
  • Quickly becoming a subject matter expert for all QA related processes.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

  • 2-3 years in operations or quality assurance and expertise in digital media advertising.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Understanding of Postback URL tracking and other performance marketing methods of tracking.
  • Experience with Tune & Yieldspark or similar tracking tools.
  • Experience with Asana or other project management tools.
  • Experience with Looker or similar BI tools like Tableau or PowerBI.
  • Proven abilities to analyze performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Proven problem solving abilities and #BetterEveryDay mindset.
  • You are proactive and will search for opportunities, not just being given tasks/tickets.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Fluent in english, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work East Coast hours consistently.

title: Senior Designer
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is looking for a Senior Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and dive deep into brand, performance, and product design. We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.

This role is for someone confident leading creative projects across a range of deliverables, from landing pages and retention flows to paid ads and digital branding, while staying grounded in strategy and results.

You’ll work closely with Retention Managers, Developers, and Designers to deliver polished work that balances brand and performance. You’ll lead initiatives independently while collaborating often, and communicate directly with clients, presenting designs, leading workshops, and managing approvals.

You’ll report to our Director of Creative and work directly with fast-growing brands where the stakes and opportunities are high. This role is designed for someone ready to take on more ownership, broaden their skills across disciplines, and grow quickly within a team that values both creativity and clarity.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone.

What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Marketing Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.

  • Create design systems based on a client’s brand guidelines to be used across multiple channels, ensuring consistency of a client’s brand identity, look, and feel.

  • Communicate with clients directly and present designs on calls, lead clients through workshopping, and obtain approvals while maintaining a strong working relationship.

  • Develop a deep understanding of what factors drive customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.

  • Design landing pages within Figma by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.

  • Collaborate with project managers and developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design updates, and more.

  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to the Design Director. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.

Requirements

Hard Skills:

  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)

  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong branding & identity, visual design, marketing design, and/or web design.

  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.

  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.

  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.

Soft Skills:

  • Highly creative individual who strives for detail-oriented design and can execute comfortably in a number of styles.

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and turn project requirements into compelling designs.

  • Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables.

  • Systematic thinker, who problem solves and time manages without heavy direction.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite

  • BFA or higher degree in Graphic Design or Fine Arts

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in-office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities, movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managing the entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un‑/loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health‑and‑safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post‑tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, GRPC, Kafka, docker, K8, AWS)

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

Disclosures

title: Research Scientist
description:
Benefits and Perks

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision insurance and mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays and flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits and a vibrant campus culture

Job Purpose

Howard University seeks a highly skilled and motivated Biomedical Research Scientist specializing in neuroscience and genomic regulation to join its growing biomedical research enterprise. The incumbent will design and implement independent and collaborative projects focused on neuroscience and molecular/cellular signaling, contributing to Howard University’s mission of advancing health equity through cutting‑edge biomedical research.

Supervisory Authority

Under the supervision of the Principal Investigator, the scientist will plan and execute the designated projects in the laboratory. Responsibilities include non‑supervisory duties and participation in training and supervision of laboratory work of students.

Nature and Scope

Internal contacts include investigators, administrators, faculty, staff and students within the department/center and University‑wide. External contacts include government agencies, scientific collaborators, vendors, visitors and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Design and execute experimental studies in molecular and cellular neuroscience with a focus on neuroprotection, neuroinflammation and genomics.
  • Perform advanced rodent stereotaxic surgeries, tissue collection, immunohistochemistry (IHC), confocal microscopy and image analysis.
  • Conduct molecular and biochemical assays (DNA, RNA, protein‑based techniques) to characterize neuronal and metabolic functions.
  • Utilize and maintain advanced imaging and spatial profiling systems (e.g., confocal, expansion microscopy, nCounter, GeoMx digital spatial profiling).
  • Analyze, interpret and present data at internal seminars, conferences and scientific meetings.
  • Prepare manuscripts, progress reports and grant proposals in collaboration with principal investigators.
  • Mentor students, fellows and research trainees in laboratory methods and research ethics.
  • Ensure full compliance with Howard University, NIH and federal policies on biosafety, animal care and research integrity.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Familiarity with digital spatial profiling, multiplex imaging or bioinformatics analysis.
  • Experience contributing to NIH‑funded research projects.
  • Prior supervisory or mentoring experience in academic or laboratory settings.
  • Advanced technical expertise in neuroscience and metabolism research.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in data management.
  • Commitment to promoting diversity, equity, inclusion and ethical research practices.

Minimum Requirements

Doctoral degree (Ph.D., M.D., D.V.M. or equivalent) in Neuroscience, Biochemistry, Physiology, Molecular Biology or a related biomedical field. At least 5 years of postdoctoral or equivalent research experience in neuroscience, molecular biology or related biomedical research areas. Demonstrated proficiency with rodent models, stereotaxic surgery, microscopy and molecular biology techniques. Strong publication record in high‑impact journals. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary research environment.

$80,000 – $90,000

title: Programador De Serviços I
description:
Job description

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Main responsibilities

  • Distribuir serviços para o cumprimento da Ordem de Serviço (OS) bem como apoiar para a agilidade da resolução da solicitação obedecendo os prazos estipulados;
  • Fiscalizar os serviços executados através de sistemas específicos;
  • Elaborar e/ou validar relatórios para controle de produtividade referente ao atendimento realizado à Ordem de Serviço (OS);
  • Dar apoio às demais áreas da empresa e atender clientes externos;

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua há 93 anos no Brasil (desde 1932), faz parte do Grupo Roemmers, multinacional com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina. No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos, cosméticos atua em 02 segmentos: Medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.

A FQM, com mais de 1500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história através de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

Desenvolver e validar metodologias analíticas para serem utilizadas pelo Controle de Qualidade para confirmar a qualidade das matérias-primas e dos produtos. Conduzir Estudos de Estabilidade a fim de determinar o prazo de validade dos produtos.

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

Under general supervision, performs supervisory, technical, and support functions of the Logistics Management Division (LMD) and does other related work.

Functions and Responsibilities

  • Acts as the unit head of the Mechanized Production Unit
  • Provides technical support to the Production Management Section (PMS)
  • Implementation of daily FFP production according to the production plan via the Mechanized Production System (MPS)
  • Supervises the preparation of material requisitions for raw materials, indirect materials and supplies/materials, non-disposable PPEs, as well as mechanized production materials issued to the workforce
  • Supervises the preparation and set up production workstations, prepositions goods/items, and performs inventory taking of raw materials used and identified as damage or defective
  • Supervises and ensures the correct distribution, collection and accounting of all supplies/materials, non-disposable PPEs, and other materials issued to workforce including raw materials left in the production area
  • Supervises the maintenance and ensures the accuracy of records of inter warehouse releases/transfers of mechanized FFP production, raw materials, indirect materials; and ensures that records are up to date at all times
  • Double-checks all daily reports before submission to the section head
  • Develops and implements standards/criteria for mechanized production of FFPs as well as other PMS activities such as manual FFP production, rice vacuum packing, rice reconditioning/milling
  • Performs other tasks as may be required from time to time

  • Communications and reports related to the functions of the Logistics Management Division and Production Management Section
  • Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly and Annual Reports regarding Mechanized FFP Production Output, Material Usage and Production Cost Report, Material Requisitions and Inventories, Rice Vacuum Packing Machine/Milling Machine Performance and others

  • Avaliar resultados e informações geradas pelas transações utilizadas atualmente pelo SAP e avaliar impactos nas atividades do setor e atuar junto aos setores pertinentes para melhoria e otimização de processos;

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Com 14 Centros de Distribuição e uma equipe de mais de 9.000 colaboradores, atuamos desde a negociação até a entrega de medicamentos e produtos de higiene e beleza para milhares de farmácias em todo o país.

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison

Location: Rio de Janeiro / Belo Horizonte

Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main responsibilities

Scientific Leadership & KOL Engagement

  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships
  • Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.g., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model
  • Work with cross-functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high-touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.g., social media, peer-to-peer communities, online portals)

Early Detection Strategy

  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence-based screening and monitoring protocols
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk-identification strategies
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level

Strategic Implementation

  • Partner with cross-functional teams in agile settings with self-organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence-based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision-makers on clinical value and health economics
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field

Individual Contributors

  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.

About you

Experience

  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus

Soft skills

  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.

Professional competencies

  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities

Technical skills

  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches

Education

  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred

Language

Advanced English required.

Why should you choose us?

  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people’s lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil’s largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership

Progress wouldn’t be possible without people; people from different backgrounds, in different locations, performing different roles, but all united by a common goal: the desire to make miracles happen. You can become one of these people. Seek change, embrace new ideas, and explore all the opportunities we have to offer. Pursue progress and discover the extraordinary with us.

At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all, regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, nationality, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is looking for exceptional security‑focused software engineers to be integrated across product teams. While they also contribute to the product as engineers, their primary focus is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security through state‑of‑the‑art practices such as threat modeling, table‑top exercises, architecture and design reviews, static analysis tools, and fuzzing, among others.

These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security, and open‑source community participation. Engineers in these roles collaborate closely with other Canonical teams, customers, and partners across the open‑source ecosystem.

Each product engineering team at Canonical reserves one or two openings for security‑oriented software engineers. We also develop a number of products driven entirely by security needs, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and the Ubuntu Security Guide (USG). As the publisher of Ubuntu, we also handle long‑term security response for the entire operating system and open‑source ecosystem. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language and design, build, and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.

Apply here if you are an exceptional security‑focused software engineer, passionate about open source, and excited by Canonical's products and mission.

This role requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through strong self‑discipline and motivation. It also involves mandatory international travel at least twice a year, typically for one week.

Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role.

What you'll do

  • Define, implement, and document new security features
  • Lead security‑focused initiatives within a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in open source software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream open source projects to benefit the community

Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho.

description:
MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA E-MULTI - AP 4.0 – SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS). Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião‑dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo das ações da atenção básica bem como qualificar a situação de saúde da população. Apoiar as equipes de saúde na família na realização do manejo das situações de saúde mental e risco psicossocial na atenção básica, propiciando, ainda, o acesso ao sistema de saúde e à reinserção social.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Especialização ou Residência em Psiquiatria com RQE;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Preencher os requisitos da Resolução SMS 4871 de 13 de Abril de 2021 , a saber:
  • RESOLVE: Art. 1º Define como requisito obrigatório para a atuação na equipe multiprofissional do Núcleo de Apoio à Saúde da Família e Atenção Básica (NASF-AB) ao menos 2 (dois) dos critérios abaixo:
    • Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação direta no saúde da família ou no núcleo de apoio à saúde da família.
    • Ter no mínimo 5 (cinco) anos de experiência profissional na área da saúde.
    • Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação em um centro de atenção psicossocial (CAPS).
    • Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação stricto sensu em saúde da família, saúde pública ou saúde coletiva.
    • Certificado de conclusão de residência ou pós-graduação lato sensu em saúde.
    • Título de especialista reconhecido pela associação médica brasileira (AMB).
    • Ter participado de 3 (três) atividades de atualização científica e/ou acadêmica nas áreas: Saúde da Família, Medicina, Saúde Pública e Saúde Coletiva (congressos, seminários, workshop, capacitações em cursos presenciais ou à distância) nos últimos dois anos antes da contratação.

Informações adicionais

Local de Trabalho: AP 4.0 (Jacarepaguá e adjacências)
