title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

Awards and Acknowledgements

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies, Fast Company\u2019s Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies. We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S., a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work.

title: Operations Analyst
description:
About Crown

We exist to make money work better. That means eliminating the friction of integrating the Brazilian Real into the blockchain economy without sacrificing trust, safety, or compliance.

With the conviction that programmable money is the future of finance, we built BRLV . Anchored by a 1:1 backing of sovereign Brazilian treasury assets, BRLV is the safe, scalable settlement layer designed for the tokenized economy.

We’re backed by Framework, Valor, Norte, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, and Nubank co‑founder Ed Wible. Our goal: R$1 trillion of BRLV in circulation within 10 years.

Role

As an Operations Analyst at Crown, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of all onboarded clients activity. You will be in charge of the transaction lifecycle, from minting and redemption of stablecoins to managing client support, responding to operational inquiries.

This role demands meticulous attention to detail, adherence to strict security protocols, and a process‑driven mindset to ensure the integrity of our operations. You will work at the intersection of technology, finance, and compliance, collaborating closely with all teams to maintain a best‑in‑class operational framework.

Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Governance and Execution: Manage and monitor all client virtual asset transactions using our institutional custody platform. Apply our Transaction Policy Engine rules, which include requiring multi‑party approval for high‑value withdrawals and blocking transfers to non‑whitelisted addresses.
  • Fiat and Crypto Operations: Oversee the daily flow of mint and redeem orders. Process BRL deposits and withdrawals while ensuring strict adherence to our rules, as well as executing the corresponding on‑chain token movements.
  • Daily Reconciliation: Perform daily reconciliation of the on‑chain token supply against the funds held in our segregated reserve accounts to ensure our stablecoins remain fully backed 1:1 at all times.
  • Client Operations Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for institutional clients regarding all post‑onboarding operational matters, including transaction status inquiries, settlement confirmations, and troubleshooting deposit or withdrawal issues.
  • Alert Management: Act as the first responder for operational alerts, such as failed transactions or transactions blocked by our policy engine. Investigate the root cause, resolve the issue, and communicate with the client as needed.
  • Process Improvement: Identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, or control gaps in our daily workflows and collaborate with the technology and compliance teams to design and implement improvements.

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a financial operations, treasury operations, payments, or "back office" role, preferably at a VASP, fintech, or regulated financial institution.
  • You are exceptionally detail‑oriented and process‑driven. In this role, precision is paramount, and you must be comfortable following complex procedures without deviation.
  • You have a foundational understanding of blockchain technology, including concepts like wallets, addresses, and transaction lifecycles.
  • You are fluent in both Portuguese and English and able to communicate clearly and professionally with sophisticated institutional clients about technical operational matters.
  • You are a resilient and emotionally intelligent professional, able to keep perfect task execution even under pressure, especially when handling high‑value transactions.
  • You thrive in ownership‑driven environments. You're highly accountable for your work and don't require others following up on it.
  • You are naturally collaborative and can work effectively with Compliance (escalating suspicious activity), Treasury (managing liquidity), and Technology (reporting system issues) teams.

What’s Different About Working Here

  • Small by design. We don’t hire layers of managers. Everyone builds.
  • Ownership is total. You own the function end‑to‑end—and ask for input when it makes the work better, not because someone’s checking.
  • Ruthlessly simple. We don’t paper over complexity with process or headcount.
  • Collaboration is default. Problems are shared property. We work across domains.
  • Feedback is candid and direct. Built on the assumption that everyone here is smart, competent, and cares.

  • Full health coverage
  • VA

As such, they must have in-depth expertise in costing and broad knowledge of the costing discipline within the project controls function.

Responsibilities

  • Lead project reviews conducted with the client and internal management.

  • Participate or lead the weekly and monthly cost and schedule review meetings.
  • Manage and maintain good client relations.
  • Actively look for areas of improvement on project and company standards.
  • Create Weekly / Monthly / Quarterly Reports.
  • Assist in resource planning, recruiting, mentoring, and evaluations.

Qualifications

  • Ten plus (10+) years of experience in Project Controls.

title: FF&E Procurement & Purchasing Junior Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

Orchestrate relationships with top-tier suppliers / manufacturers and spearhead cost-effective procurement strategies tailored to the unique demands of our UTOPIA LIVING operations.

In general will be responsible for ordering, administration and supply procurement of the FF&E, OS&E, design and supply within the team. It will be your responsibility to ensure that the orders are made on time, within budget and in the most efficient manner, ensuring that the Finance Department is kept informed of all necessary compliance.

At a glance:

  • FF&E/Fit Out Budgets and Cost Planning
  • Tendering and Market Research
  • Contracts and Purchase Orders management
  • Payment Forecast and Cost control
  • Logistic, Delivery and Installation plus Handover

You will:

  • Collaborate with Sr. FF&E Procurement Manager, Architects and Senior FF&E/Interior Designer to ascertain the timeline, budget and deadlines of the project
  • Assist the FF&E/Interior Designer with sourcing all the information necessary to complete the detailed specification document
  • Work with the design team to build the initial procurement schedule based on the review of layouts, renderings & specifications of the project
  • Responsible for the compilation of the procurement budget and coordinating all documentation ensuring all document standards are met
  • Organize the purchasing schedule, liaising with the Sr. Procurement and Project managers to ensure all project milestones are reached
  • Working closely with the Finance team to raise Funding Requests, produce purchase orders and pay proforma invoices in timely manner
  • Receive, approve and pass invoices for payment and log on procurement schedule
  • Liaise with suppliers across the globe to obtain quotes and discuss terms of service
  • To work within set budgets and timeframes, ensuring items meet the required specification and can be delivered on time
  • Liaise with internal teams and contractors to organize FF&E logistics and installation
  • Quality control
  • Ensure all supplier contacts are up to date
  • Carry out existing supplier reviews & new supplier visits in order to provide a list of approved suppliers to consideration on projects
  • Maintain accurate procurement & budget records & collate information for a weekly procurement review
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, Supply Chain or Logistic, preferably Master’s degree in any of above
  • Project Management degree (Master’s or equivalent) is a plus
  • Must have a minimum of 3 years experience within a procurement agency or design studio in a similar role.
  • Advanced/fluent in English and Portuguese - required
  • Experience dealing with global projects and suppliers - markets across Europe, Brazil, DR, and Latin America advantageous.
  • Experience in establishing and executing new processes
  • Experience in preparing O&M Manuals for Hospitality projects

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

Overview

Join to apply for the Sr. Product Designer role at Lumenalta .

Experience Remote done Right. Over 20 years of remote experience, all 500+ staff are 100% remote and we still grow vibrant relationships, provide exceptional opportunities for career growth while working with stellar clients on ambitious projects.

What we’re working on

As a product designer, you will discover the business goals and develop the use cases for different user personas. At Lumenalta, you can expect that you will:

  • Be 100% dedicated to one project at a time so that you can hone your skills, innovate and grow
  • Be a part of a team of talented and friendly senior-level developers
  • Work on projects that allow you to use cutting edge tech. We believe in constantly evolving your mastery

The result? We produce meaningful work and we are truly proud and excited to be creating waves in an industry under transformation.

Job is 100% Remote, please make sure you have a comfortable office set at your desired work location.

This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in Latin America (LATAM). title: Systems Engineer - Tendering & FEED
description:
Lead Subsea Systems Engineer (Front-End Engineering)

Are you a Systems Engineer looking for an interesting and inspiring opportunity? Are you passionate about Front End Engineering and Development Studies? Join our innovating Engineering team! Bringing cutting-edge physical and digital technologies together to create subsea systems – the beating heart of our work. Devising smarter systems that control and monitor oil and gas extraction, our subsea products and flexible pipe capabilities are industry leading. Our team provides support for customer operations to ensure continuity for production.

Partner with the best

You will be challenged to lead Front End Engineering & Development studies, giving support to projects and technology development at a system coordination level. You will also support execution of subsea projects, support regional sales and commercial teams, and interact with customers providing technical expertise during early engagement activities.

Responsibilities

  • Executing system design to proposals and projects.
  • Reporting progress, technical and interface matters in project meetings and progress reports of assigned tasks and CTRs.
  • Defining system layout from concept definition phase to FEED, detail engineering and execution phases of a subsea project.
  • Defining and preparing functional specifications for subsea system building blocks such as trees, controls, wellhead connections, manifolds, and flowlines.
  • Acting or supporting the study manager with technical interface, change control, technical variations, and general delivery of the scope.
  • Providing system design input to large subsea project proposals and equipment contracts.
  • Liaising with clients on a technical level to ensure their needs are met and ensuring they are aware of data-input requirements to allow the study to proceed on-schedule.
  • Supporting the OFE sales and commercial organization in identifying and pursuing opportunities related to early engagement or invitations to tender.
  • Assisting in the preparation of proposals as part of a proposals team or technical peer checker.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a MSc or BSc degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Controls Engineering or equivalent with extensive experience in a similar role.
  • Have broad knowledge of processes, methods and procedures within project and engineering management.
  • Have proven experience in front-end design activities, covering concept, pre-FEED and FEED studies.
  • Have proven experience in design and selection across one or more of the following: field architecture, flow assurance, system analysis, interface management, requirement management, process engineering, subsea production systems, risers, flowlines and pipelines, control systems, constructability and installation.
  • Have demonstrable depth of experience in project engineering within a multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Be available to travel internationally for project needs and for short-term assignments.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours – flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities.
  • Comprehensive private medical care options.
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs.
  • Tailored financial programs.
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits.

About Us

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we’re committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we’re always looking for the right people to help us get there. title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

Descrição da vaga
Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de ser a melhor empresa de saneamento para o Brasil.
Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

VENHA TRABALHAR COM A GENTE!
⚡Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito: ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.
Desde então, somos uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas com os serviços prestados por nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. Atuamos com o compromisso de proporcionar qualidade de vida e saúde à população atendida por meio de um trabalho de qualidade no fornecimento de água tratada e de coleta, afastamento e tratamento de esgoto. O nosso jeito de ser é marcado pelo DNA inovador que proporciona um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e de muitos aprendizados, gerando grande impacto na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito as diferenças estão presentes na empresa para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independente de suas crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos a equidade e respeito e em nossas equipes então venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação! Já somos mais de 2.500 colaboradores e estamos expandindo em um ritmo acelerado e com perspectiva para muito mais!

title: Data Associate - Upstream and Carbon Management (UCM)
description:
Data Associate - Upstream and Carbon Management (UCM)

Join to apply for the Data Associate - Upstream and Carbon Management (UCM) role at Wood Mackenzie .

Wood Mackenzie is the global data and analytics business for the renewables, energy, and natural resources industries. Enhanced by technology and enriched by human intelligence, we provide reliable and actionable insights that help companies and governments lead the transition to a sustainable future. With over 50 years of experience and a team of more than 2,400 experts across 30 global locations, we deliver real‑time analytics, consultancy, events, and thought leadership to enable confident decision‑making.

The Opportunity

Our UCM Data team builds, enhances, and maintains the data that underpins Wood Mackenzie’s unique understanding of the energy and natural resources sectors. Data is the key driver behind Wood Mackenzie’s mission to transform the way we power the planet.

The Role

Join the team to analyze critical oil and gas industry data, focusing on data management, pipeline development, and quality assurance challenges while collaborating across Data, Research, and Product teams. You will work closely with colleagues worldwide to understand how our diverse teams (Research, Data, Technology, Sales, Marketing, and more) collaborate to create and deliver value for our clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of energy data workflows and customer needs.
  • Manage and maintain our market‑leading data assets.
  • Deliver analytics solutions through integrated datasets and automated pipelines.
  • Ensure data quality ownership while meeting client requests with high standards.
  • Identify and document system optimization and improvement opportunities.
  • Apply agile methodologies to foster continuous improvement and measurable success.
  • Maintain GIS platforms and databases using industry best practices.
  • Collaborate across teams to deliver data assets.

Requirements

  • Experience in data roles with a focus on ingestion, cleansing, and quality management.
  • Degree in a relevant field (Oil & Gas Exploration, Geology, Petroleum Engineering) or equivalent industry experience.
  • Proficiency in SQL and both relational and NoSQL database systems.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (Power BI preferred).
  • Experience with GIS software such as ArcGIS (desired).
  • Experience applying technology solutions using agile methodologies.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Passion for emerging data technologies.
  • Experience with Python programming and familiarity with AWS cloud platform (a plus).
  • Experience with API integration (preferred).
  • Spanish language skills (desired).

What’s In It For You

  • Valuable work experience and a comprehensive insight into the work of a leading research organisation.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a research project, enabling you to put theory into practice.

title: Senior Email Marketing Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior Manager, Retention—a seasoned CRM strategist and operator who brings equal parts creativity, technical depth, and leadership maturity to the table. This is not a maintenance role; it requires strategic ownership, hands‑on execution, and a bias for measurable impact. You’ll lead a team of lifecycle marketing experts to build sophisticated email, SMS, and loyalty programs that drive retention, increase LTV, and power sustained growth for a portfolio of fast‑scaling e‑commerce brands. This role demands sharp customer insight to turn data into strategy, comfort with complexity, and the ability to influence clients and internal stakeholders alike. You’ll report to our Director of Retention and collaborate closely with Performance, Creative, and Strategy teams to deliver cohesive, cross‑channel campaigns rooted in data and customer psychology.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for retention marketers who want to do the best work of their careers—operating at the intersection of personalization, loyalty, and performance‑driven innovation.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Mexico, Brazil, and Spain.

You Should Apply if this sounds like you:

You’re passionate about e‑commerce and digital marketing. You immersed in the world of direct‑to‑consumer growth marketing. We're looking for an expert Senior Manager, Retention to join our team! In this role, you will join a growing team within the Retention Marketing Department to strategically develop customized CRM and retention marketing strategies that help our clients grow and scale through email and SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs.

  • 7+ years of work experience in digital marketing.
  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e‑commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.
  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
  • You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
  • You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life:

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for select clients, working to develop best‑in‑class retention strategies. On a weekly basis, you will meet with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email and SMS programs.
  • Provide support and guidance to help Retention Specialists analyze data, develop winning retention strategies and create reports for clients happiness.
  • Project manage and delegate client tasks to your team, consisting of both specialists and designers. Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client.
  • Coordinate cross‑departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams to develop cohesive and creative campaigns that drive client growth.
  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
  • Execute on automation/flow logic set‑up, pop‑up builds, and app integrations.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
Role Profile – Front-End Subsea Systems Engineer Moscow

Job Title: Systems Engineer – Front End Engineering Team

Responsible to: Front-End Engineering Manager

Business Segment: Oilfield Equipment

Function: Subsea Production Systems

Hiring Manager: Thomas Versavel

Overall Role Description

Systems engineering is an outcome driven collaboration with customers through a focussed and proactive approach to the front-end space of an oil and gas development. It requires a holistic view where a ‘systematic’ approach to design is deployed. This necessitates a robust understanding of project value drivers, key technical challenges and overarching parameters including reservoir performance and subsurface profiling, flow assurance boundary conditions and system operability, environmental conditions, constructability, design life and intervention requirements, and abandonment and decommissioning frameworks.

As a Senior systems engineer, you will be operating within a multi-disciplinary team. You will be challenged to lead Front End Engineering & Development studies, where you will give support to projects and support technology development at a system coordination level. You will also support execution of subsea projects. You may be accountable for cost, schedule and HS&E performance and support project management activities.

You will be supporting the regional sales and commercial teams in interacting with Customer, providing technical expertise support during early engagement activities, leading to contract award.

Key Responsibilities

Primary Duties

Technical:

  • Maintain operational reporting to assigned study manager and ability to act as a study manager as required.
  • Providing system design input to large subsea project proposals and equipment contracts
  • Project engineering and lead role for system layout and definition from concept definition phase to FEED, detail engineering and execution phases of a subsea project
  • Development of subsea system field concepts and optimizations
  • Define and prepare functional specifications for subsea system building blocks such as Trees, Controls, Wellhead connections, Manifolds, and Flowlines
  • Interface definition and management amongst different work packages, BAKER HUGHES locations and towards the client
  • Reporting of progress, technical and interface matters in project meetings and progress reports of assigned tasks and CTRs.
  • Assist R&D initiatives on field optimization and design reviews

Quality

  • Ensuring the work is performed in accordance with BAKER HUGHES Quality Management Systems.

Client interfacing:

  • Liaises with clients on a technical level to ensure their needs are being met and ensuring they are aware of the data input requirements to allow the study to proceed on-schedule.
  • Provides technical leadership as required on studies, projects and other tasks assigned by line manager.

Business Development

  • Supports the OFE commercial organization in identifying and pursuing opportunities related to early engagement.
  • Proposals
  • Assists in preparing proposals as part of a proposals team or technical peer checker

Specialist Tasks and duties (as deemed required)

  • Support execution phase of projects
  • Use and develop internal systems and software tools for undertaking engineering tasks leading to safe and successful delivery of jobs.
  • Seek out and promote application of new technology to enable promotion and positioning of BAKER HUGHES to the market

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Master’s Degree or bachelor’s degree with 7+ years of experience
  • Strong interpersonal and communications skills, both verbal and written
  • Broad knowledge of processes, methods and procedures within project and engineering management
  • Demonstrable depth of experience in project engineering within a multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Knowledge of all aspects of the Subsea Systems Engineering Lifecycle from NPI, Tender development, Project Engineering, SIT, commissioning, and operations
  • Proven experience in design and selection across one or more of the following: Field architecture / Flow assurance / System Analysis / Interface Management / Requirement Management / Process engineering / Subsea Production Systems / Risers, flowlines and pipelines / Control systems / Constructability and installation.
  • Availability to travel internationally for project needs and for short term assignments

About Us:

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us:

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

Job Description

The Senior Product Designer will support and lead the way into creating intuitive, user-centered digital experiences within Landmark’s Information Management and Platform Technologies Development team. This role focuses on designing workflows and interfaces that improve usability, clarity, and consistency across critical service delivery applications, including drilling optimization platforms, reservoir modeling tools, and wellbore performance analytics, among others.

As a key member of the design team, the designer will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and senior designers to translate user needs and business requirements into effective design solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong interaction and visual design skills with a collaborative mindset and a passion for delivering high-quality, production-ready designs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive design for complex product features and workflows, ensuring alignment with user needs and business objectives.
  • Evolve and maintain design system standards, ensuring scalability and consistency across applications.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and polished visual designs for production-ready experiences.
  • Lead usability testing, synthesize insights, and advocate for data-driven design decisions.
  • Provide feedback and mentorship to mid-level and junior designers, fostering growth and design excellence.
  • Partner with stakeholders to influence product strategy and ensure seamless implementation.
  • Support design reviews, promote best practices, and contribute to a culture of innovation and collaboration.

Required Qualifications

  • 6-10 years of experience in User Interface, User Experience or Product Design.
  • Bachelor’s, specialization’s or master’s degree in design, Fine Arts, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Industrial Design, Product Design, User Experience or a related field.
  • Proficiency in modern design software and tools such as Figma, Framer or equivalent.
  • Solid knowledge working with and maintaining Design Systems.
  • Deep understanding in interaction design, visual design, responsive design and usability principles/standards.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrates broad expertise in various design disciplines and successful project delivery.

title: Software Engineer - Python and K8s
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Our mission is to reinvent the way companies manage their open source information systems - on public clouds and in their own data centers. To achieve that we are building a new community around Python opscode for open source applications, running on Kubernetes. We want to move all of Canonical and Ubuntu IS onto this new, open source codebase. We are confident that we can dramatically improve the experience of running complex business operations - and then we can help our customers embrace those new techniques and products. Traditionally, IS is an inward-facing operation. We would like to transform our IS team into an extension of the product engineering capability at Canonical. Our internal workloads are in many cases the same open source workloads that our customers want to operate. This team will productize those workloads for real-time automated operations on Kubernetes. This role is ideal for software engineers who enjoy Python, have a passion for distributed systems, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers. It is a role that requires rigor in both code and customer interactions. Our engineers are technically astute open source enthusiasts who are excited about cloud computing and are ready to join a global team charged with delivering world class services to our customers.

The role entails

  • Work in Python to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work across the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Learn to think rigorously about application and infrastructure reliability
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure
  • Simplify open source operations for our customers and open source community
  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code
  • Follow agile software development practices
  • Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with company values
  • Work from home with global travel once or twice a year for up to 2 weeks for events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You are experienced with Linux systems administration, package management, and operations
  • You have hands-on experience with at least one public cloud
  • You are familiar with Docker and Kubernetes
  • You are an experienced Python programmer and enjoy challenging projects
  • You understand the importance of reliable software and strive to design and code to that expectation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Consultor de Campo - Base Rio de Janeiro
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

O Kumon é uma multinacional japonesa euma das maiores redes de educação do mundo; estamos presente em mais de 50 países, somando mais de 4 milhões de alunos. No Brasil, nossas quase 1500 unidades atendem todas as regiões e com isso, nos consolidamos também como a maior rede de franquiano segmento de educação do país.

O método Kumon maximiza a capacidade dos alunos, descobre qual é o ponto ideal de estudo para cada ume fornece aos mesmos,material didático eficaz; o consultor de campo atua diretamente com a rede franqueada no intuito de contribuir para o desenvolvimento de nossas unidades e consequentemente dos alunos.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições de um Consultor de Campo Kumon:

Realização de Visitas e Treinamentos Específicos às Unidades Franqueadas

  • Apoiar e desenvolver orientadores e franqueados, promovendo integração e capacitação contínua.
  • Adaptar a abordagem conforme o perfil e o momento de cada franqueado, assegurando a correta aplicação do Método Kumon.
  • Planejar e realizar treinamentos direcionados às necessidades específicas das unidades, fortalecendo a autonomia e a qualidade da operação.

Elaboração de Relatórios e Planos de Acompanhamento

  • Elaborar planos de ação e acompanhamento com base nos principais indicadores (matrículas, IC6, TMP).
  • Preparar relatórios de visitas e manter informações atualizadas para as áreas de suporte e gestores.
  • Acompanhar resultados e propor estratégias de melhoria contínua.
  • Apoiar a implementação de ferramentas digitais e garantir a organização de agendas e processos.
  • Contribuir com planos e iniciativas para fortalecer a marca Kumon.

Coordenação e Realização de Reuniões

  • Coordenar e apresentar reuniões regionais e gerais com franqueados, garantindo comunicação clara e integração entre as unidades.
  • Dar suporte na condução de reuniões com pais de alunos e eventos de fortalecimento da marca.
  • Atuar como ponte entre matriz e unidades, mantendo o fluxo de informações consistente e transparente.

Consultorias Personalizadas

  • Oferecer consultorias alinhadas às necessidades e ao perfil de cada unidade franqueada.
  • Acompanhar e avaliar a eficácia das orientações, analisando resultados e propondo planos de desenvolvimento específicos.
  • Promover a troca de boas práticas e o fortalecimento da rede de franqueados.

Análise de Dados

  • Gerenciar e analisar dados para acompanhar indicadores de desempenho das unidades.
  • Interpretar resultados e propor ações estratégicas que apoiem o crescimento sustentável e a melhoria dos indicadores-chave.
  • Utilizar ferramentas digitais para monitoramento e suporte à tomada de decisão.

Satisfação dos Franqueados, Alunos e Pais

  • Contribuir para a satisfação e fidelização dos franqueados, alunos e pais, por meio de uma atuação próxima, empática e orientada a resultados.
  • Apoiar eventos e ações que promovam o engajamento e o fortalecimento da marca Kumon nas regiões.

Para continuarmos aumentando ainda mais o valor do método Kumon e assim, atingirmos o maior número de crianças possível, buscamos profissionais com as seguintes características:

  • Ensino Superior completo (graduação completa);
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Inglês (desejável);
  • Experiênciacom franquias, áreas de negócios, área comercial e/ou consultorias

(atuação na área da Educação será considerado um diferencial);

  • Experiência com redes sociais e tecnologia em geral;
  • Disponibilidade para viagem;
  • Residir em Rio de Janeiro e/ou região
  • Identificação com a área daeducação, método e filosofia da empresa.

Nós, do Kumon, valorizamos todos os esforços para construir um ambiente e uma cultura nos quais todos os colaboradores tenham a garantia de uma vida com tranquilidade; por isso oferecemos benefícios visando o bem estar e também o desenvolvimento de colaboradores e familiares. Explicamos um pouco mais com a descrição abaixo.

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Assistência Médica: Plano apartamento sem custo para o colaborador e com taxa fixa para dependentes diretos (não é co-participação).
  • Assistência Odontológica: Opcional.
  • Auxílio Creche: Para colaboradores com filhos até 5 anos.
  • Assistência ao Filho Deficiente.
  • Conexa saúde: Programa de apoio aos colaboradores para assistência e orientações especializadas nas áreas psicológica e nutricional (sem custo para o colaborador).
  • Vidalink: Auxilio Medicamentos para todos colaboradores sem desconto até o teto limite mensal.
  • Gympass que agora é Wellhub

Alimentação:

  • Vale Refeição.
  • Vale Alimentação.
  • Auxílio Coordenador de Franquias: Bônus semestral, em folha de pagamento, nos meses de junho e dezembro de cada ano.
  • Vale Transporte: Nos dias de trabalho presencial.
  • PLR: Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (anual).

Educação:

  • Subvenção Educação: Subsídio para apoiar o desenvolvimento profissional (respeitando o valor limite).
  • Estudo Gratuito do Material Didático de Todas as Disciplinas do Kumon: Todos os colaboradores poderão realizar o estudo do material didático do Kumon de todas as disciplinas, utilizando 30 minutos de sua jornada de trabalho diária.
  • Reembolso para Estudo pelo Método Kumon: Disponível em unidades franqueadas para colaboradores e dependentes legais.
  • Idiomas: O colaborador poderá usar o valor teto para o estudo dos idiomas Inglês, Espanhol ou Japonês (independente do estudo pelo Método Kumon).
  • Day-Off Aniversário: O colaborador terá o dia do aniversário abonado pela empresa ou poderá escolher um dia na semana posterior ao aniversário, quando este cair no final de semana.
  • Plano de Carreira.
  • Step 4: Palestra e Dinâmica 4 Palestra e Dinâmica
  • Step 7: Entrevista 2 com Gerentes e/ou Diretores 7 Entrevista 2 com Gerentes e/ou Diretores

O Kumon é uma metodologia que visa incentivar na criança a AUTONOMIA nos estudos, buscando FORTALECER o POTENCIAL de aprendizado de cada um. Por meio de um processo de aprendizagem planejado e individualizado, o aluno se torna confiante e capaz de enfrentar sozinho o desafio da conquista do conhecimento.

Vem conferir!

  • Vendas e Registro de Vendas: Realizar vendas de produtos de venda livre e registrar as transações com precisão. Processar pagamentos em dinheiro, cartão de crédito ou outros métodos de pagamento aceitos pela farmácia.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Verificar regularmente o estoque de medicamentos e produtos, repor itens conforme necessário e garantir que os produtos estejam dentro do prazo de validade. Manter registros precisos de estoque.

  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza! Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana, da superação de resultados, do foco no cliente, da sustentabilidade, da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil. Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde. Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos. Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente. Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

description:
Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Cumprimentar os clientes de forma cortês e prestativa, ajudando a esclarecer dúvidas, fornecendo informações sobre produtos, incluindo dosagem, uso e possíveis efeitos colaterais.
  • Dispensação de Medicamentos: Dispensar medicamentos prescritos com precisão, seguindo os regulamentos e procedimentos da farmácia. Certificar-se de que os pacientes recebam as orientações adequadas sobre o uso de medicamentos.
  • Vendas e Registro de Vendas: Realizar vendas de produtos de venda livre e registrar as transações com precisão. Processar pagamentos em dinheiro, cartão de crédito ou outros métodos de pagamento aceitos pela farmácia.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Verificar regularmente o estoque de medicamentos e produtos, repor itens conforme necessário e garantir que os produtos estejam dentro do prazo de validade. Manter registros precisos de estoque.
  • Conhecimento de Produtos: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos disponíveis na farmácia, incluindo suas características, benefícios e possíveis interações medicamentosas.
  • Atendimento Telefônico: Atender chamadas telefônicas de forma profissional, responder a perguntas dos clientes.
  • Organização: Manter a área de atendimento ao cliente e as prateleiras organizadas. Garantir que produtos perigosos sejam armazenados adequadamente e de acordo com as normas de segurança.
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento em Informática Básica;
  • Desejável experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar em escala 6x1.
  • Experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva);
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida e Assistência Funeral;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Gestão de Orçamento e Controlo de Custos

  • Desenvolver, rever e manter os procedimentos de Orçamento e Controlo de Custos do Projeto, incluindo o Procedimento de Reporte de Custos/Orçamento e o Procedimento de Faturação, de acordo com as regras do Afiliado e da PJC.

  • Consolidar, controlar e coordenar todas as atividades de monitorização do orçamento e custos do projeto, incluindo orçamento LOP (Life of Project), orçamentos anuais e custo final estimado (EFC).
  • Acompanhar todas as atividades do projeto, assegurando que as tarefas realizadas são validadas para permitir a autorização da faturação durante toda a duração do projeto (gestão de compromissos, alterações contratuais, valores provisórios).
  • Analisar potenciais derrapagens e desvios do caminho crítico, estimando seus impactos nos custos.
  • Comparar custos reais com LOP e orçamentos anuais, identificando desvios e propondo revisões quando necessário.
  • Coordenar e consolidar os relatórios de custos do projeto para utilização interna e para partes externas (filial, sede, parceiros, autoridades).

Ações Específicas

  • Atualizar a CBS do projeto sempre que necessário.
  • Elaborar, atualizar e rever o relatório de custos/orçamento do projeto.
  • Monitorizar as atividades dos engenheiros de controlo de custos de EMPREITEIROS e FORNECEDORES.
  • Monitorizar os relatórios de custos e faturação do CONTRATANTE.
  • Verificar e comentar os procedimentos de custos/orçamentação de Empreiteiros e Fornecedores.
  • Apoiar o Gestor de Projeto e o Gestor de Controlo do Projeto em análises de custos, simulações de desvios e atualizações do orçamento LOP.
  • Participar em revisões e auditorias técnicas relacionadas com custos.
  • Fornecer relatórios mensais de custos detalhados e precisos.
  • Colaborar com o Engenheiro de Planeamento para validação da faturação do Empreiteiro com base no progresso e marcos contratuais.
  • Apoiar a área financeira da filial (controlo de custos, contabilidade, pagamentos) na integração dos relatórios de custos e no tratamento da faturação.
  • Monitorizar custos do RFS e o calendário de pagamentos.

Saúde, Segurança e Ambiente (HSE)

  • Cumprir integralmente as instruções de segurança, saúde e proteção.
  • Manter vigilância contínua aos riscos e ao ambiente de trabalho.
  • Comunicar à Direção quaisquer problemas identificados e propor melhorias.
  • Participar, quando solicitado, em reuniões técnicas e revisões como COMOPS, SIMOPS, Hazid, Hazop, revisões de projeto e avaliações de risco.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Gestão, Finanças ou área relacionada.
  • Experiência comprovada em controlo de custos, orçamento e gestão financeira de projetos complexos, preferencialmente no setor de O&G ou infraestruturas.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de CBS, WBS e metodologias de planeamento e controlo de projetos.
  • Experiência com contratos EPCI, FPSO ou projetos industriais de grande porte (desejável).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de controlo de custos, ERP e MS Excel; conhecimento de softwares de planeamento (ex.: Primavera, MS Project) é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretação de desvios, cenários e impactos financeiros.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e de coordenação com equipas multidisciplinar e partes externas.
  • Compromisso com normas de HSE.
  • Fluência em português; inglês avançado.

description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high‑security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy‑to‑use, high‑quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail‑oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP‑based systems through high‑quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.

Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing

Key Responsibilities

  • Create or edit linguistically‑rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.

Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.

Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test – evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills.
  • Versant English Proficiency Test – focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency. A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify.

Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding. Action required: XConnect registration. You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect. Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. description:
Mecânico de Manutenção - Unidade Del Castilho (Rio de Janeiro)

Atento – Unidade Del Castilho, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Descrição da vaga:

Profissional que irá efetuar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva, conforme PMOC Plano de Manutenção, Operação e Controle do sistema de ar condicionado , atendimentos emergenciais, atuando com reparo e manuseio de equipamentos e sistemas de ar condicionado , incluindo bombas hidráulicas, substituindo peças e efetuando testes funcionais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Executar rondas e rotinas diárias de serviços tais como: ligar e desligar equipamentos;
  • Efetuar inspeções e verificar condições de operação dos equipamentos e sistemas, casas de máquinas;
  • Verificar níveis de ruído dos equipamentos;
  • Efetuar leitura e medições nos equipamentos;
  • Efetuar medições das condições ambientais;
  • Efetuar regulagens necessárias nos equipamentos e sistemas;
  • Verificar níveis de reservatórios em geral;
  • Verificar possíveis vazamentos e entupimentos em geral;
  • Atender chamados de reclamações pertinentes;
  • Verificar existência de irregularidades nos ambientes condicionados;
  • Visualizar sistemas de supervisão e possíveis alarmes;
  • Detectar eventuais deficiências dos sistemas e equipamentos, atuando na prevenção de falhas, minimizando defeitos e possíveis impactos;
  • Efetuar manutenções conforme as recomendações dos fabricantes, e check list de atividades de manutenção;
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar os serviços contratados de empresas especializadas em Tratamento de Água, Análise de Qualidade do Ar e Manutenção de Resfriadores de Líquido e Condicionadores de Ar.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Idade a partir de 18 anos;
  • Ter no mínimo o Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Curso profissionalizante ou técnico em refrigeração e climatização ou curso técnico em mecânica, eletrotécnico ou eletromecânica (preferencialmente pelo Senai ou Instituições equivalentes);
  • Experiência de no mínimo 06 meses na área, principalmente com refrigeração/climatização;
  • Desejável experiência como mecânico de manutenção de ar-condicionado (chillers, centrífugas, selfcontained, fancoils e Split);
  • Será um diferencial ter experiência em funcionamento e manutenção de bombas hidráulicas, acessórios, noções básicas de solda, ler e interpretar desenho técnico, catálogo de peças, conhecer medidas do sistema métrico e inglês;
  • Ter fácil acesso a Atento Del Castilho.

Informações adicionais

Salário: R$ 2.100,00

Horário de Trabalho: Das 09:00 às 18:48 – FUNDAMENTAL ter flexibilidade de horário, pois se necessário, poderá trabalhar a noite ou em plantões aos finais de semana para realizar serviços que não podem ser executados durante a escala convencional visando não comprometer o funcionamento pleno Operacional.

Jornada de Trabalho: 220h/mês | Escala 5X2 com folgas sábados e domingo

A Turner & Townsend é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais com mais de 22.000 colaboradores em mais de 60 países. Trabalhando com nossos clientes nos setores de imobiliário, infraestrutura, energia e recursos naturais, transformamos juntos, entregando resultados que melhoram a vida das pessoas. Trabalhamos em parceria e tornamos possível entregas dos projetos e programas mais impactantes do mundo, transformando desafios em oportunidades e complexidade em sucesso. Nossos serviços incluem Gestão de Programas, Projetos, Custos, Ativos e Comercial, Controles e Desempenho, Compras e Cadeia de suprimentos, soluções para emissões zero e Digital. Somos majoritariamente de propriedade do CBRE Group, Inc., a maior empresa de serviços imobiliários comerciais e investimentos do mundo, com nossos parceiros detendo uma participação minoritária significativa. Turner & Townsend e CBRE trabalham juntos para fornecer aos clientes a melhor oferta de gestão de programas, projetos e custos em mercados ao redor do mundo.

Descrição da Vaga

Profissional será responsável por apoiar o gestor do projeto no planejamento e controle financeiro de portfólio de projetos, garantindo o alinhamento com o planejamento estratégico do cliente.

  • Garantir a consolidação da carteira de projetos em diferentes fases do ciclo de implantação, assegurando o cumprimento dos requisitos de governança e controle financeiro estabelecidos.
  • Realizar as atividades em interface com as áreas de orçamentação, gestão e elaboração de relatórios financeiros.
  • Consolidar informações e apoiar a execução das atividades da área.
  • Apoiar atividades de rateios e imobilização de ativos para projetos concluídos.
  • Realizar os orçamentos anual e plurianual para implantação de projetos.
  • Receber, avaliar e distribuir os documentos de medição, incluindo a conferência de documentos para medição (conforme check list do Cliente), das memórias de cálculo e evidências de execução, em conformidade com as condições contratuais.
  • Atividades de controle de lançamentos nos PEPs e apropriações de custos por natureza, incluindo utilização dos respectivos módulos do SAP.
  • Elaboração, conferência e revisão de memórias de cálculo de serviços executados e validar medições de Contratadas. Inclui a utilização do sistema LECOM.
  • Elaboração de relatórios.

Qualificações

  • Desejável formação superior em Engenharia (todas as especialidades), Tecnologia (todas as especialidades), Estatística, Administração ou Economia.
  • Vivência no setor de Óleo & Gás.
  • Proficiência em MS Office, SAP. Desejável conhecimento em Power BI.
  • Conhecimento em Gerenciamento de Projetos e práticas do PMI (desejável).
  • Experiência em Planejamento Financeiro de Projetos (desejável).
  • Vivência em ambiente corporativo, com compreensão de processos e governança.
  • Experiência em medições e gestão de contratos.
  • Visão abrangente do ciclo de vida de implantação de projetos (desejável).
  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação – Categoria B.
  • Inglês (desejável).

Informações Adicionais

Nossos funcionários inspirados compartilham nossa visão e missão. Proporcionamos um ótimo lugar para trabalhar, onde cada pessoa tem a oportunidade e a voz para causar mudança. Queremos que nossos funcionários tenham sucesso no trabalho e na vida. Para apoiar isso, promovemos um ambiente de trabalho saudável, produtivo e flexível que respeita o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. A Turner & Townsend é uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais. Celebramos a diversidade e estamos comprometidos com a criação de um ambiente inclusivo para todos os funcionários e incentivamos ativamente candidaturas de todos os setores da comunidade. A Turner & Townsend não aceita currículos especulativos ou não solicitados que tenham sido enviados à nossa equipe de recrutamento interno ou aos gerentes de contratação de agências fora da nossa lista de fornecedores preferenciais ou que não tenham seguido o devido processo. title: Analista de Informações Operacionais Jr
description:
Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Analista de Informações Operacionais Júnior

Para atuar em análises, acompanhamento de indicadores e apoio aos processos regulatórios e financeiros ligados aos produtos de seguros da companhia.

Quais serão os seus desafios

  • Realizar o acompanhamento do reajuste anual das contribuições de seguros, entendendo impactos, cálculos e regras aplicáveis;
  • Garantir o correto entendimento e análise dos produtos de seguros, considerando suas particularidades, composições e diferenças estruturais;
  • Acompanhamento de KPIs e variáveis de controle;
  • Levantamento e análise de comportamentos atípicos;
  • Elaboração de justificativas técnicas;
  • Questionamento crítico sobre números e resultados;
  • Interface constante com o time financeiro, garantindo que os prêmios emitidos estejam de acordo com o previsto e colaborando para correções e justificativas quando necessário;
  • Atuar no batimento das bases de dados, relacionadas às inscrições dos planos instituídos e de previdência pública, entre a MAG e os Parceiros;
  • Acompanhar a execução automática da rotina de cancelamento e atraso, com base nas regras definidas pela Política de Operações;
  • Trazer insights e análises a partir da interpretação de dados (prêmios, apropriações, valores emitidos etc.);
  • Utilizar ferramentas de IA para ganho de escala, automação e otimização de atividades;
  • Preparar apresentações, relatórios e explicações claras sobre análises realizadas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação preferencialmente nas áreas de Atuarial, Estatística, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Pacote Office (principalmente Excel);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de explicar análises complexas de forma clara;
  • Raciocínio analítico e habilidade para interpretação de dados;
  • Interesse e/ou uso básico de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em Python para automações e análises;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Experiência prévia com Lean (gerenciamento diário/KPI) é um diferencial.
